policyChecks.CLEARMeaning: Availability/exclusions/preferences/conditional relationships must be faithfully preserved without necessary personal/local facts being guessed or materially different interpretations selected. This permits date-by-24-hour availability ranges plus relationships, not a unique instant/interval or complete personal structuring output.
policyChecks.rangeAndConditionalPreservation: Intentional broad/unrestricted optional restrictions and valid other-availability dependencies are expressly allowed; one date/time interval is not forced.
policyChecks.bindingAndNecessaryMissingFacts: Material missing facts/references/date-time-place bindings and conflicting own conditions are review candidates. Optional unspecified restrictions do not become mandatory.
policyChecks.amPm: No default morning/evening; unqualified time is explicitly not interpreted as intentional permission for both.
policyChecks.clearNoMatch: No candidates/outside search dates alone is not ambiguity. No participation or closing policy changes.
policyChecks.selfConflictVersusRepair: A flags possible conflict but returns only an existing label, not a generated question or two-choice repair; direct-edit versus choice remains the later generator/gold distinction.
policyChecks.preservationAndFinalAnalysis: Polarity, exceptions, scope and original conditions retained; no text rewriting/regex semantic rules/other-input invention/personalAREA merge; final whole-room interpretation remains separate.
policyChecks.security: Participant JSON treated as untrusted data; only supplied choice returned, with no questions or extracted/rewritten conditions. Existing strict wire parser/closed label schema remains required.
policyChecks.unchangedChoiceDescriptions: Three descriptions are the original production descriptions; only instructions is the prospective change.
